source_name: НБРСМ — Банкарска супервизија и регулатива (hub)
why_relevant: Top-level hub of the supervision function: branches into decisions, instructions, licensing, reports. Best single entry point to enumerate all A3 banking-regulation sub-sections.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлуки од областа на супервизијата
why_relevant: The canonical list of binding supervisory decisions (одлуки) — capital, risk management, corporate governance, consolidated supervision, licensing. Each item links to consolidated text and Official Gazette numbers carrying entry-into-force dates.

source_name: НБРСМ — Регулатива за платните системи и платежните услуги
why_relevant: Payments-side counterpart of the supervision register: decisions and instructions under ЗПУПС governing payment institutions, e-money institutions and payment system operators — core A3 payments regulation surface.

source_name: НБРСМ — Подзаконски акти коишто произлегуваат од Законот за платежни услуги и платни системи
why_relevant: Dedicated index of the ~12 bylaws adopted under ЗПУПС (Sl. vesnik 90/22, applied from 1 Jan 2023) — exactly the deadline-bearing secondary legislation A3 tracks for payments market entry.

source_name: НБРСМ — Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (act page)
why_relevant: Regulator-hosted page for the primary payments law and its amendments; anchor for tracing which bylaws and compliance deadlines derive from which article.

source_name: НБРСМ — Закон за Народната банка на РСМ (act page)
why_relevant: Constitutive law defining NBRM's rule-making and supervisory mandate — needed to interpret which instrument types (одлука / упатство / решение) are legally binding and on whom.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за издавање дозволи (consolidated PDF)
why_relevant: Shows the site's /content/Regulativa/ PDF store pattern — consolidated ('пречистен текст') act texts are directly downloadable, which is the highest-fidelity artefact for compliance-deadline extraction.

source_name: НБРСМ — Упатства (implementing instructions) sections
why_relevant: 'Упатство' is NBRM's implementing-instruction instrument; these carry reporting templates, submission formats and hard reporting deadlines that banks/PSPs must meet — operationally the most deadline-dense layer below decisions.

source_name: НБРСМ — Соопштенија (press releases) 2026
why_relevant: Year-indexed press-release stream announcing Council sessions and newly adopted decisions, usually days before/around Official Gazette publication — the fastest early-warning signal for new regulation and deadlines.

source_name: НБРСМ — Совет на Народната банка (Council composition & mandate)
why_relevant: The Council is the body that formally adopts bylaws; knowing its composition and meeting cadence lets A3 anticipate when regulatory decisions land.

source_name: НБРСМ — Платежни институции, институции за електронски пари и оператори на платни системи
why_relevant: Supervisory landing page for the licensed non-bank payments population; links to the statutory registers whose content changes are the observable output of licensing decisions.

source_name: НБРСМ — Регистар на институции за електронски пари
why_relevant: Statutory e-money institution register kept under the ЗПУПС licensing decision; a structured, low-noise dataset showing whether the new payments framework is actually producing market entrants.

source_name: НБРСМ — Банки (banking sector / supervised banks section)
why_relevant: Authoritative list/landing for licensed banks and savings houses; the population to which every supervisory deadline applies.

source_name: НБРСМ — Кредитен регистар (Credit Register section)
why_relevant: Credit Register decision + implementing instruction define mandatory reporting content and submission deadlines for all credit providers — a recurring A3 compliance obligation with periodic template revisions.

source_name: НБРСМ — Национален совет за платните системи
why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder body (NBRM + banks + ministries) where payments-policy direction and forthcoming rule changes are discussed before drafting — a consultation-stage signal for A3.

source_name: НБРСМ — Информации за потрошувачите: Регулатива
why_relevant: Consumer-protection regulatory strand (fee transparency, most-representative-services list, fee information documents) — payments conduct rules with concrete implementation dates for banks and PSPs.

source_name: НБРСМ — Извештаи за ризиците во банкарскиот систем
why_relevant: Quarterly supervisory risk reports state where the regulator sees problems — the reliable leading indicator of which rulebook it will tighten next; also documents how new decisions bit in practice.

source_name: НБРСМ — English regulation mirror (Regulation on Payment Systems and Payment Services / About)
why_relevant: NBRM mirrors much of its regulatory site in English via the '-en.nspx' suffix; useful for cross-checking translations of act titles and for downstream reporting, though English pages lag the Macedonian originals.

source_name: ЈП Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette)
why_relevant: Legally authoritative publication venue: an NBRM decision is binding and its entry-into-force clock starts from Gazette publication. Essential to pin exact issue numbers and dates behind every NBRM act.

source_name: ЕНЕР — Единствен национален електронски регистар на прописи
why_relevant: National consultation portal for draft regulation (incl. finance-sector laws such as Закон за финансиските друштва). Catches the pre-adoption stage that NBRM's own site rarely exposes; ministry-driven, so it covers laws NBRM later implements.

source_name: Meta.mk / Bankarstvo.mk — Macedonian coverage of NBRM regulatory acts
why_relevant: Local media restate NBRM adoptions in plain language with dates ('12 подзаконски акти', application from 1 Jan 2023) and surface regulator statements (e.g. NBRM calling for debate on bank fees) that hint at future rule-making. Useful as a change-detection tripwire and for context, never as the legal source.

source_name: НБРСМ — Програма за работа на Народната банка (annual work programme)
why_relevant: This is the closest thing NBRM publishes to a regulatory work programme / calendar: the Council adopts a Work Programme each December (e.g. Programme for 2026 adopted 5 Dec 2025) listing planned regulatory activities for the year. It is the single best forward-looking A3 artefact for anticipating which decisions will be drafted and when.

source_name: НБРСМ — Стратегиски план на Народната банка (multi-year strategic plan)
why_relevant: Rolling 3-year strategic plans (2019-2021, 2020-2022, 2022-2024, and per press coverage a 2025-2027 plan) set the medium-term regulatory agenda that the annual Work Programme operationalises. Gives 2-3 year lead time on themes (EU acquis alignment, payments, resolution, digitalisation) before any draft decision appears.

source_name: НБРСМ — Регулатива (bank supervision decisions index)
why_relevant: Master index of supervisory bylaws (Одлука за начинот на вршење супервизија и надзор, Одлука за методологијата за управување со ризиците, Одлука за издавање дозволи/согласности, Одлука за објавување извештаи и податоци, etc.). Consolidated texts ('пречистен текст') are republished here after each amendment, so it is the authoritative endpoint for confirming that a consulted draft became binding.

source_name: НБРСМ — Закони (laws index, incl. Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems)
why_relevant: NBRM's curated list of the primary laws it administers (Banking Law, Law on the National Bank, ЗПУПС, Law on Bank Resolution, FX Law). Primary-law amendments are the trigger for waves of NBRM bylaw drafting, so a change here is a leading indicator of many downstream A3 deadlines.
